note: Ten additional silhouette studies. These alternatives do not replace the approved baseline.

concepts.name: 05-rounder-envelope
concepts.direction: Gently round the blue outer bottom-left and bottom-right corners so the three-piece cluster has a softer oval-like overall envelope. Keep the upper inward curve snug beneath red. The bottom remains fairly shallow. A small, natural refinement of the target.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is an EDIT TARGET: the Chit crayon avatar with a large tomato-red upper-left piece, small golden-yellow upper-right piece and a cobalt-blue curved lower piece that cups them.
Create ONE closely related refinement. Preserve the red and yellow pieces as closely as possible: same location, size, orientation, silhouette, vivid colors, diagonal crayon scribbles and tiny pale pigment gaps. Preserve the overall square framing, centered scale and ample empty margins.
Refine the BLUE lower piece so all three pieces together have a recognizable, compact, unified outer silhouette. Keep blue tucked beneath the other two, never dangling far below like a separate triangle. Exactly three colored pieces. Their outside edges should suggest one hand-formed pebble or simple shape. Keep slim clean transparent separation between the pieces; do not merge the colors, overlap the red and blue, or add a separate border/background.
Maintain the same flat wax-crayon / dry oil-pastel grain, slightly ragged freehand edges and naive diary feel. No shiny material, gradients, shading, outlines, labels, text, faces, eyes, plants, animals, extra dots, embellishments or fourth shape. No precision-perfect geometry. Keep a genuine transparent background, not black paint or a checkerboard.
Change only the specified geometry of blue and the minimal gaps needed to make it fit. Output one avatar, not a comparison sheet.
Variation direction: Gently round the blue outer bottom-left and bottom-right corners so the three-piece cluster has a softer oval-like overall envelope. Keep the upper inward curve snug beneath red. The bottom remains fairly shallow. A small, natural refinement of the target.
